translations.web: how in much proof of affliction, the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded to the riches of their generosity.
translations.bsb: In the terrible ordeal they suffered, their abundant joy and deep poverty overflowed into rich generosity.
translations.kjv: How that in a great trial of affliction the abundance of their joy and their deep poverty abounded unto the riches of their liberality.
